incident.injected_fault: The inventory controller's namespace Role omits get and list access to its inventory-settings ConfigMap, so its ServiceAccount receives RBAC Forbidden responses.
observable_signals: Inventory reconciliation fails with Kubernetes API Forbidden errors.
SelfSubjectAccessReview denies get and list on the required ConfigMap resource.
The controller pod is otherwise ready and can reach the API server.
preconditions: The inventory ServiceAccount, ConfigMap, and namespace are fixed by the fixture.
The API server and controller dependencies are healthy.
The controller requires only the benchmark-declared ConfigMap operations.
required_evidence: Capture the pod ServiceAccount and referenced RoleBinding subjects.
Capture effective Role rules for the bound identity.
Run impersonated can-i or SelfSubjectAccessReview checks for the exact verbs and resource scope.
Show successful reconciliation after a least-privilege change.

payload.rationale: The inventory-settings-reader Role in namespace proofix-case-09 grants get access on pods instead of configmaps, causing authorization failures (403 Forbidden) when inventory-controller queries the inventory-settings ConfigMap. Patching the Role to grant get and list on configmaps restores access with least privilege.
payload.rollback_trigger: HTTP 5xx error rate exceeds 0.001 or reconciliation continues to fail.

success_criteria.description: The inventory-controller ServiceAccount can read configmaps in namespace proofix-case-09, /inventory returns 200 OK, and 5xx error rate drops below 0.001.

critical_claims.claim: Role 'inventory-settings-reader' in namespace 'proofix-case-09' only permitted 'get' on resource 'pods' in apiGroup '', lacking required ConfigMap permissions.
RoleBinding 'inventory-settings-reader' binds Role 'inventory-settings-reader' to ServiceAccount 'inventory-controller' in namespace 'proofix-case-09'.
The inventory workload runs under ServiceAccount 'inventory-controller' and queries GET /api/v1/namespaces/proofix-case-09/configmaps/inventory-settings using the mounted ServiceAccount token.
The kubectl auth can-i check for ServiceAccount 'inventory-controller' to get 'configmaps' in namespace 'proofix-case-09' failed due to RBAC authorization rejection.
The target ConfigMap 'inventory-settings' exists with valid configuration data in namespace 'proofix-case-09'.
Role 'inventory-settings-reader' was successfully patched to grant the required ConfigMap permissions.
All SLO targets are met across consecutive observation windows with zero error rate and p95 latency below 200ms.

closure.summary: The inventory-controller workload experienced RBAC authorization failure because its bound Role 'inventory-settings-reader' granted permissions on pods rather than configmaps. Patching the Role resolved the RBAC deficit, restoring reconciliation and satisfying all SLO thresholds.
